scope: Exactly four candidates from P5_CN_REGEN_ROUND2_PROPOSAL.json. This artifact proposes quota mappings only and does not modify the canonical ledger, selection, P4, routing, or state.

validator_count_basis.counting_note: Counts assume the explicit canonical normalizations below are applied before selection validation. Proposed records with noncanonical source_type or demand_evidence_type strings must not be merged verbatim.

candidates.concept: Retrofit X-ray computed-laminography kit for advanced-packaging failure analysis

existing_source_association_rationales.L15-001: Defines packaging maturity as a limiting factor in high-temperature SiC power electronics, supporting the target package-failure context without claiming X-ray performance.
existing_source_association_rationales.L15-005: Catalogues mechanical and thermal-cycling characterization of sintered-silver die attach, supplying concrete package-defect and ground-truth targets for the blinded imaging study.
existing_source_association_rationales.L15-017: Covers nano-silver die-attach reliability in SiC power modules, adding a distinct advanced-package interface and failure family for classifier validation.
existing_source_association_rationales.L15-025: Reviews power-cycling reliability of SiC power devices, supporting recurring thermomechanical failure-analysis jobs in power packaging.
existing_source_association_rationales.P5-CNREGEN-S07: A primary JCET filing places advanced-packaging equipment completion in H2 2028, directly supporting the proposed post-installation yield-learning window.
existing_source_association_rationales.L05-034: Comet's filing reports material X-ray-system and module revenue and names an incumbent system family relevant to cabinet replacement and retrofit competition.
existing_source_association_rationales.L05-033: Varex's filing establishes active industrial X-ray/NDT module orders and shipments, supporting the installed-equipment ecosystem while not proving packaging-specific retrofit demand.
existing_source_association_rationales.P3R2-F-01-S04: The accepted official 2026-2030 plan provides the China integrated-circuit policy/timing source and replaces the duplicate proposed mirror P5R2-CN-S06.

residual_evidence_deficits: Only P5R2-CN-S04 is directly about X-ray tomography for advanced-packaging failure analysis; the other four peer sources support package failure modes and qualification context, not laminography reconstruction or retrofit accuracy.

Before a P6 deep dive, add direct peer-reviewed evidence on limited-angle/computed laminography, sparse-view reconstruction, and cabinet-geometry calibration; do not infer the proposed sensitivity or throughput from the current five-paper quota set.

candidates.concept: Vendor-neutral dirty-return helium purification and custody-mass-balance skid for cryogenic facilities

proposed_new_source_normalizations.acceptance_note: The official government procurement-intention notice names the buyer, system category, and budget; treat it as a buyer procurement notice, not an award.

existing_source_association_rationales.L07-002: Directly covers helium leak detection, cryosorption, diffusion barriers, and clean assembly at extreme vacuum, relevant to the skid's contamination and loss-accounting boundary.
existing_source_association_rationales.L07-018: Shows that working-fluid choice affects 4 K cryocooler capacity and COP, supporting the operational value of helium quality without proving the proposed purifier's performance.
existing_source_association_rationales.L07-023: Provides a helium-leak measurement method relevant to closing the custody mass balance and separating physical loss from inventory-accounting error.
existing_source_association_rationales.L07-024: Demonstrates helium detection under a difficult gas background, relevant to contaminated-return diagnostics and leak localization.
existing_source_association_rationales.L03-026: Documents a large superconducting-magnet system using 4.5 K supercritical-helium cooling, providing a concrete host-system boundary and commissioning context.
existing_source_association_rationales.L07-041: ITER's open tender specifies liquid/gaseous helium, minimum purity, and a EUR4M-EUR12M range, establishing current buyer spend and the economic importance of helium custody.
existing_source_association_rationales.L13-028: DOE's QIS-center award funds instrumentation and new refrigeration methods, supporting an independent US cryogenic-facility validation route and counting as an official project award.

residual_evidence_deficits: The peer quota is substantively tied to helium detection, cryogenic working-fluid sensitivity, and host-system operation, but it contains no direct paper on mixed dirty-return helium purification, impurity breakthrough, or custody-grade mass-balance uncertainty.
Before P6, add direct separation-science and metrology papers for oil/moisture/nitrogen/oxygen removal, adsorbent breakthrough, analyzer calibration, and recovery-loss accounting.

candidates.concept: Field-deployable industrial high-temperature heat-pump commissioning and measurement-and-verification island

proposed_new_source_normalizations.acceptance_note: DOE's official funded project record supports a field-validation route; it is not evidence of a commercial purchase order.

existing_source_association_rationales.L04-007: Models transient behavior in a complete thermodynamic cycle, supporting the need for synchronized boundary measurements under ramps rather than steady-state snapshots.
existing_source_association_rationales.L04-103: Reports an experimental performance test of a 150 kW compressor in a waste-heat-recovery cycle, relevant to traceable compressor/system performance testing at the proposed power scale.
existing_source_association_rationales.L04-111: Evaluates control-valve effects on load-following dynamics, supporting the product's focus on variable-load transient M&V and auxiliary/boundary definition.
existing_source_association_rationales.L14-028: An experimental liquid-cooling system reports COP across measured flow conditions, providing an adjacent Chinese full-system instrumentation and COP-calculation precedent.
existing_source_association_rationales.L04-049: Documents a 300-550 C industrial advanced-heat-pump deployment at a named methanol plant and provides direct customer commentary, supporting current industrial high-temperature-heat demand.

residual_evidence_deficits: Only P5R2-CN-S14 directly addresses heat-pump monitoring; the other four peer sources are adjacent thermodynamic-cycle, compressor-test, transient-control, and COP-measurement precedents.
Before P6, add direct industrial high-temperature heat-pump field-M&V papers covering steam enthalpy, auxiliary loads, uncertainty propagation, seasonal fouling, and acceptance-boundary conventions.

candidates.concept: China-local dry point-of-use arsine-abatement cartridge platform for compound- and power-semiconductor exhaust

proposed_new_source_normalizations.acceptance_note: Use as an official customer-system capacity/geography record, not as a procurement award.

existing_source_association_rationales.L06-012: Demonstrates high-removal point-of-use-style semiconductor CVD exhaust abatement using a different mechanism, supporting the exact semiconductor-exhaust job and an incumbent technical alternative.
existing_source_association_rationales.L01-017: Reviews nonthermal-plasma VOC abatement as an alternative industrial-gas treatment route, useful for mechanism and competitor comparison rather than dry-arsine performance.
existing_source_association_rationales.L01-018: Includes field work on decomposition of industrial-exhaust VOCs, supporting real-site abatement boundary conditions and measurement practice.
existing_source_association_rationales.L01-019: Provides a current review of industrial VOC removal mechanisms and catalyst design, relevant to competing abatement architectures and scale-up risks.
existing_source_association_rationales.L01-021: Reviews packed-bed plasma reactors, relevant to pressure-drop, bed/reactor configuration, and alternative packed-bed abatement, while not validating arsine chemisorption.

residual_evidence_deficits: None of the five accepted peer sources directly tests dry AsH3 chemisorption media, guard-bed breakthrough, endpoint sensing, spent-media stability, or semiconductor-fab cartridge qualification.

The quota is numerically valid because the peer sources substantively cover semiconductor/industrial exhaust abatement and alternative packed-bed mechanisms, but P6 must add direct hydride-gas sorbent and hazardous-waste evidence before any safety or cartridge-life claim is made.

global_recount.note: This is a selection-quota mapping, not a claim that every product-specific P6 evidence gap is closed. Residual directness deficits are explicit per candidate.
